sections.title: Fair Value for Global Compute
sections.body: Pricing at Kenya AI Compute is based on physics, not speculation. Our rates are a direct reflection of our $0.04/kWh energy cost and efficient modular OPEX. We offer three primary billing tiers. 'On-Demand' is perfect for rapid testing and short experiments. 'Reserved' (1, 6, or 12 months) offers deep discounts for predictable workloads like model fine-tuning or steady-state inference. Finally, our 'Spot' instances allow you to bid on spare capacity at market-bottom rates, ideal for non-critical rendering or training tasks. When you compare our $0.70-$1.00 per GPU-hour against the $2.00-$4.00 charged by US-based providers, the decision becomes simple: your R&D budget goes 2-3 times further with Kenya AI Compute. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models. Each phase includes checkpoints on capacity, uptime, and unit economics so stakeholders can track progress with confidence.
